nodes.label: ADR-008: TanStack Query + Zustand for Frontend State Management
nodes.rationale: Mixing server state and client/UI state in one store (e.g. Redux or Zustand alone) leads to manual cache-invalidation bugs and double-state drift. Chose a clear split: TanStack Query v5 owns all server data (caching, staleTime, invalidation, retries) while Zustand v5 owns UI/client state (active farm, auth user, subscription view, modal state); React Hook Form v7 + Zod v4 (shared schemas from @sawithub/shared) own form state. Trade-off: two state libraries to learn; TanStack Query v5's breaking changes from v4 make older tutorials misleading; Zustand's module-level singleton stores require explicit `setState(initialState)` resets between Vitest cases; shared Zod schemas must be manually kept in sync with backend validation.
